{{Introduction
|introduction      = '''''Unreal''''' is a {{Glossary:Singleplayer}} and {{Glossary:Multiplayer}} {{Glossary:First-person}} {{Glossary:FPS}} game in the ''[[Series:Unreal|Unreal]]'' series developed by [[Company:Epic MegaGames|Epic MegaGames]] and [[Company:Digital Extremes|Digital Extremes]] and published by [[Company:GT Interactive|GT Interactive]]. The game marks the origin of [[Engine:Unreal Engine 1|Unreal Engine]], a proprietary game engine that would see future iterations and be licensed to other developers.

|release history   = ''Unreal'' was first released for [[Windows]] on May 22, 1998, followed by a [[Mac OS]] port by [[Company:Westlake Interactive|Westlake Interactive]] on September 1, 1998.

|current state     = ''Unreal'' enjoys active community support via the [[#OldUnreal 227 Patch|OldUnreal 227 Patch]].

}}
